title: TRACE-FV: Reference Implementation and Reproducibility Assets
description: Dependency-free Python reference implementations of the primary TRACE-FV v2.1 scoring estimands, with a fully synthetic worked example, expected outputs, unit tests, continuous integration, and a byte-identical archive of the registered public Object A protocol package. This software release contains no official pilot data and makes no empirical validation claim.
notes: Mixed-license deposit: source code is Apache-2.0; documentation, synthetic fixtures, expected outputs, and frozen Object A materials are CC-BY-4.0 unless a file states otherwise. The related OSF DOI identifies the registered parent protocol, not this software release.
